semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company produces components used in semiconductor vacuum systems, which are essential for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Wenzhou Zhibo Mechanical Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of stainless steel vacuum flanges and fittings, valves, and centrifugal pumps primarily for semiconductor vacuum systems. Their products are also utilized in electronic, solar energy, bio-medicine, and food and beverage industries, ensuring high quality through advanced machining and quality assurance systems.
capabilities: Stainless steel vacuum flanges and fittings
